decisions.rationale: Leads Excadrill + Sinistcha per plan: Excadrill LO High Horsepower OHKOs H-Arcanine (their win condition) even at -1, while Sinistcha's Heatproof + Rage Powder soaks Flare Blitz/Extreme Speed and its own Trick Room cancels Farigiraf's. Back Tyranitar gives sand (Sand Rush answer to Noivern Tailwind) plus spread Rock Slide on Arcanine/Noivern; Rotom-Heat resists Fire and Pixilate Hyper Voice, is Ground-immune, and Will-o-Wisps Kingambit/Arcanine while Thunderbolt handles Milotic/Noivern.

SIM QUIRKS: Fighting resisted by Psychic. Rock NOT resisted by Rock. Sandstorm damages Grass (chips Sinistcha). Armor Tail doesn't stop self-target priority. Protect counter resets when skipped; consecutive 1/3, 1/9. Protect (+4) beats TR ordering. Using Trick Room while TR up ENDS it.
VERIFIED L50: Exca LO High Horsepower (205 Atk) OHKOs H-Arcanine (215-397%, even at -1). Exca LO Iron Head vs Farigiraf 40-74%. Gholdengo MiR (Wise Glasses) spread vs Mega Gard 63-108%; at -2 SpA Gholdengo is dead weight. Ground 4x on H-Arcanine; Rock Slide 2x but spreads past single Protect. Dark is neutral-to-SE on Steel (Gen6+): Kingambit hits Gholdengo 2x.
FOE DAMAGE: H-Arcanine ExpertBelt Flare Blitz OHKOs Gholdengo/Excadrill; Head Smash 0.25x vs Exca; ExtremeSpeed 0x vs Ghost. Farigiraf Psychic vs Gholdengo 18-27%, resisted by Exca. Rotom-Heat resists Fire and Fairy, immune Ground; weak to Rock (Head Smash) and Water (Scald).
OPPONENT TENDENCIES: very Protect-reliant — blocks obvious single-target KOs and Protects when partner is threatened; re-sets Trick Room repeatedly with Farigiraf; spends Mega Gardevoir as an early trade; Arcanine recklessly spams Flare Blitz.
GAME 3 PLAN: Team = Excadrill + Sinistcha lead, Tyranitar + Rotom-Heat back. Kill H-Arcanine early with Excadrill Ground move or redirect it with Rage Powder. Deny TR with Sinistcha TR-cancel; avoid bringing sand while Excadrill needs to be slow under TR. Tyranitar sand only when Tailwind/speed race matters.

decisions.rationale: Lead Farigiraf+Kingambit: Farigiraf sets Trick Room while Kingambit (immune to sand, resists Rock Slide) Protects or attacks. Armor Tail blocks opposing priority including Rage Powder. Back Arcanine-Hisui (Intimidate, Flare Blitz/Head Smash under TR) and Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate Hyper Voice threatens Tyranitar, Aura Sphere for Excadrill). Arcanine's Rock/Fire coverage handles Gholdengo, Rotom-H, and Floette.
decisions.notebook: Game 3: Farigiraf TR + Arcanine sweep is primary win condition. Kingambit lead protects TR setup. Gardevoir-Mega provides Fairy spread pressure. Opponent sand core (Tyranitar+Excadrill) likely; Gholdengo has Thunderbolt for our Water types. Sinistcha's Rage Powder blocked by Armor Tail. Track Protect counts across all mons to exploit consecutive-use failures.

decisions.rationale: Excadrill outspeeds both foes; LO High Horsepower is 2x on Kingambit for 81-139%, likely OHKOing the mon that most threatens Sinistcha (Kowtow Cleave 72-125% = possible OHKO) and that snowballs with Supreme Overlord. Matcha Gotcha is the best hedge: if Kingambit Protects it still chips Farigiraf 19-35% (low base SpD) and pressures the TR setter; if HH rolls low it adds residual on Kingambit. Setting our own TR would just cripple Excadrill if Farigiraf declines TR.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Kingambit)
decisions.rationale: Safest TR setup: Kingambit Protects to dodge Excadrill's potential OHKO High Horsepower (75-130%). Farigiraf sets TR at -7 priority. If Sinistcha also TRs they cancel but both mons survive at full HP; if Sinistcha attacks instead, TR resolves with Kingambit healthy for the sweep under reversed speed. Armor Tail already blocks Rage Powder so redirection isn't a concern.

Under TR Kingambit acts before Excadrill, but its Protect is on the reduced 1/3 counter after last turn, so High Horsepower (80.7-139.4%) should land. Matcha Gotcha adds 8.7-16.6% on Kingambit (combined min ~89%, likely KO), chips Farigiraf further toward a KO range, and heals Sinistcha. Rage Powder would only invite Kowtow Cleave into my frail-to-Dark Sinistcha; mirroring Trick Room would just waste a turn since TR actually lets Excadrill outpace Arcanine/Gardevoir/Milotic.

Rotom-Heat instead covers the remaining threats: immune to Ground, resists Fire (Arcanine Flare Blitz) and Fairy (Mega Gardevoir Hyper Voice), and only risks Psychic (24.8-69.6%) from Farigiraf on entry. Keeps Tyranitar in reserve for post-Trick Room turns.

decisions.rationale: Under TR, Farigiraf (72) and Kingambit (70) both move before foes. Double-targeting Sinistcha: Psychic (34–64%) + Kowtow Cleave (73–133%) guarantees KO (min 107%). Removing Sinistcha denies Trick Room reversal and Matcha Gotcha sustain. Excadrill likely retaliates with High Horsepower into Kingambit (77–130%), but the trade is favorable—we keep TR, Farigiraf, and a healthy backline against a weakened Excadrill.

Arcanine-Hisui provides immediate Intimidate value on Excadrill, is immune to Sand damage if Tyranitar switches in, and has Extreme Speed to bypass TR when needed. Under TR, Farigiraf (72 Speed) moves first, and Sand Rush Excadrill moves last, giving us two attacks before its Ground move threatens. Flare Blitz hits Excadrill 2x. Gardevoir-Mega is threatening but vulnerable to Steel moves from both Excadrill and potential Gholdengo.

Rotom's Overheat into Farigiraf is 43.6-80.5% with a KO chance from 70%, pressuring the repeat Trick Room setter while Farigiraf's Psychic/Hyper Voice are resisted by Excadrill. Worst case both foes Protect and I lose nothing meaningful.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Arcanine-Hisui)
decisions.rationale: Cancel Trick Room so Arcanine's 132 Speed has ~73% chance to outspeed Excadrill (108–140) and OHKO with Flare Blitz before High Horsepower connects. If Arcanine wins the tie, Excadrill faints and we send Gardevoir to form a strong 2v2. Farigiraf is likely KO'd by Rotom-Heat but has already done its job setting TR. This line maximizes win probability over relying on Protect coin flips or staying in TR where fast Arcanine moves last.

decisions.rationale: Only Gardevoir remains on the bench. It must fill one active slot; the other stays empty. Slot choice is arbitrary with a single Pokémon. Gardevoir-Mega under Trick Room will move last but has Pixilate Hyper Voice as a Fairy spread option against Excadrill and Rotom-Heat.

Gardevoir is their last Pokémon; only KO matters. Excadrill Iron Head is 2x (78.9-158% even at -1 Atk with Life Orb) and under Trick Room Excadrill (118) acts before Mega Gardevoir (120+), with a 30% flinch backup. Rotom Thunderbolt adds 13-23% to close low rolls without further tanking its SpA (Overheat's 90% acc and -2 more isn't worth ~6%). Doubling up also beats a Protect read at worst by only losing tempo, since Tyranitar remains in reserve.

Removing Excadrill now gives best odds in the 1v4 uphill battle after TR expires.

reflections.summary: Won 4-0 (only Sinistcha lost) because the Excadrill/Rotom-Heat core matched every threat the opponent brought: LO High Horsepower is a clean answer to Kingambit and 4x on H-Arcanine, Iron Head OHKOs Mega Gardevoir on the switch-in, and Rotom-Heat (Ground-immune, Fire/Fairy-resistant) removed Farigiraf with Overheat + Thunderbolt. The opponent's Trick Room plan collapsed once Kingambit died turn 2 and Farigiraf fell turn 4, leaving Mega Gardevoir to be spent as a lone sacrifice. The one real cost
reflections.adjustment: Change the lead, not the four: bring Excadrill + Rotom-Heat as the opening pair against a Kingambit/Farigiraf front, keeping Sinistcha in reserve only for Arcanine (Heatproof) or as an anti-Milotic redirector. If Sinistcha must be led, do not click Matcha Gotcha into a Protect-happy Farigiraf on turn 1 — use Rage Powder/Trick Room denial instead of chip. Continue to decline mega-relevant risk by holding Tyranitar until Gardevoir is gone or Trick Room has expired, then use sand for Sand Rush Exca

reflections.summary: We brought Trick Room with Farigiraf, but the opponent’s Excadrill was minimum speed (slower than our Arcanine and Gardevoir-Mega) and moved before them under Trick Room. After Kingambit traded for Sinistcha, we had no answer to Excadrill, which swept our remaining Pokémon before they could attack.
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring Trick Room against this opponent without a reliable way to KO Excadrill first. Preserve Kingambit to handle Excadrill under Trick Room, or bring a faster mode that doesn’t rely on Trick Room. Consider a different Mega Evolution that can survive Iron Head or outspeed Excadrill outside Trick Room.
reflections.notebook: Game 3: Opponent's Excadrill is minimum speed (likely 0 Spe) to move first under Trick Room. Rotom-Heat has speed investment (faster than Farigiraf, slower than Arcanine). Sinistcha confirmed Heatproof. Opponent sand core: Tyranitar Smooth Rock, Excadrill Life Orb Adamant min speed. Avoid Trick Room without a plan to remove Excadrill. Kingambit's Sucker Punch threatens Excadrill outside Trick Room. Gardevoir-Mega's Aura Sphere is super effective but needs to survive Iron Head. Future games: consider fast mode or double-target Excadrill early.
